profileLabel: Mixed economics; mixed electoral institutions (low confidence)
summary: Kalinga representative with 142 principal-authored bills. Reviewed evidence is mostly co-authorship on tax amnesty, education subsidy, women's protection and electoral bills.
caveat: Almost entirely co-authored multi-sponsor bills; low confidence. The extraction found no principal-authored ideological bills.

economic.label: Center / mixed
economic.rationale: Co-authored estate-tax amnesty extension (market-leaning) and tertiary education subsidy expansion (redistributive); no other economic bills found among 142 principal-authored. Balanced on thin, co-authored evidence.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB06614, HB00609, HB08476, HB06636 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Insufficient evidence
social.rationale: Only gender-equality evidence (co-authored technology-facilitated violence against women bill, HB08420).

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB08420 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

civil.label: Insufficient evidence
civil.rationale: Fewer than two adequately evidenced issues in the sources reviewed; left unscored.

democratic.label: Institution-supporting
democratic.rationale: Co-authored anti-dynasty bills but also co-authored postponement of the 2026 barangay elections and five-year barangay terms. Contradictory, co-author-only evidence yields a weak institutional-support lean.
